summary.text: Annie Graham is a Democratic state representative from Maine House District 105, in office since December 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A pediatric nurse practitioner who lives in North Yarmouth, she also served in the House from 2010 to 2014.

paragraphs.text: Anne Graham earned a B.S. from Boston College in 1981 and an M.S. from Yale University in 1986.
Her career experience includes working as a pediatric nurse practitioner.
Graham represented District 109 in the Maine House from 2010 to 2014 and returned to the House for District 105 in December 2022, succeeding Joel Stetkis.

According to Ballotpedia's most recent committee information, last updated in September 2023, she chaired the Bills in the Second Reading Committee and served on the Health and Human Services Committee.
